simple.meaning: כִּלְיָה (kilyâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a kidney (as an essential organ ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 31 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms, and 4 more, beginning at Exodus 29:13. Its contexts include altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כִּלְיָה (H3629).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
